description: KEY FIELDS (per row in `upcoming[]` / `past[]`): `event_kind` (not `kind`), `title`, `expected_on` + `date_precision` + `window_end`, `entities[].entity_code`, `importance`, `status`. One A-share security's dated events as two lists: `upcoming` (nearest first) and `past` (most recent first, within the look-back). `limit` applies to each list separately. ⚠️ Only `date_precision = day` rows are pinned to a day; for week/month/quarter/half/year rows `expected_on` is the START of the window (`window_end` is the far edge) — never render it as the event date. ⚠️ `expired` does NOT mean it did not happen — the window closed without confirmation reaching us; `cancelled` means withdrawn. `certainty: confirmed` on a research-sourced row is not an exchange filing.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

limit.description: Max rows PER LIST (1-500, default 100) — upcoming and past are capped separately

past_days.description: Look-back window in days (1-365, default 90). The library only retains 90 days of past events, so a longer look-back simply returns nothing extra.

name: events_timeline
